text_e.en:
[CN][name:0] shall take a different form.
[CN]Will you proceed?

text_e.ko: [CN]지금은 모습을 바꿀 수 있는 포켓몬이 없구나.
text_e.before:
[CN]This place serves no purpose to you.
[CN]Begone.

text_e.ko: [CN]지금은 모습을 바꿀 수 있는 포켓몬이 없구나.[C]
text_e.before:
[CN]This place serves no
[CN]purpose to you now.[C]
[CN]Begone.

text_e.en:
[CN]Pokemon can evolve here when
[CN]their usual requirements are met.[C]
[CN]Those with an earlier evolutionary stage
[CN]may also choose Regression.[C]
[CN]Those with another supported form
[CN]may choose Change Form.[C]
[CN]These changes retain levels, experience,
[CN]moves, IQ, nicknames and permanent boosts.
text_e.ko:
[CN]일반적인 진화 조건을 갖추면
[CN]이곳에서 진화할 수 있다.[C]
[CN]이전 진화 단계가 있는 포켓몬은
[CN]퇴화도 선택할 수 있다.[C]
[CN]다른 폼으로 바꿀 수 있는 포켓몬은
[CN]폼 변환을 선택할 수 있다.[C]
[CN]모습이 바뀌어도 레벨, 경험치, 기술,
[CN]지능, 별명과 도핑값은 유지된다.
text_e.before:
[CN]There are those among Pokémon
[CN]that can evolve.[C]
[CN]Such Pokémon can evolve at this very
[CN]spot if they satisfy certain conditions.[C]
[CN]Evolution brings about changes
[CN]in appearance and abilities.[C]
[CN]Not only that, some Pokémon even change
[CN]type and learn different moves.[C]
[CN]However...[K]the requirements for
[CN]evolution differ among Pokémon.[C]
[CN]Some become ready for evolution
[CN]merely by leveling up.[C]
[CN]Still others may need special items
[CN]to attain evolution.[C]
[CN]You must also be aware of this:[C]
[CN]once it has evolved, a Pokémon
[CN]can never regain its previous form.[C]
[CN]That is why you must think carefully
[CN]before committing to evolution.

text_e.en:
A relic from another dimension.
It is no longer required for evolution.
text_e.ko:
다른 차원에서 온 유물.
이제 진화에 필요하지 않다.
text_e.before:
An odd stone from an other dimension.
It allows certain kinds of Pokémon to
evolve.
